page.layout: One page of text, single column, dictionary entries in Latin with Syriac, Chaldean and Hebrew words; no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right.

main_text.p: טַעַם Ch. & Syr. Guftare, deguftare. Aphel אַטְעֵם Guftare facere, guftandum dare, Genef. 24. 17. Deinde Syr. Inferere, ad Roman. 11. 23. quomodo quidam per metathefin litterarum deducunt à טַעַם: vel à Guftando, quòd ramus aut furculus infitus, fuccum arboris guftet eoque alatur. Ethpahel ܐܬܛܥܡ Inferi, ibid. Pahel טַעֵם Guftandum dare, Dan. 4. 22. & 5. 21.
טַעַם, טַעֲמָא, טְעָם Ch. Guftus, Sapor proprie: & metaphoricè, Ratio, Confilium, Sententia, Judicium. Plural. טַעֲמִין.

טַעַן Ch. & Syr. Onerare, onus imponere: Onuftū esse, ferre, portare, asportare, adferre. Pahel טַעֵן Figere, transfigere, fodere, confodere, transfodere. Ithpehal אִתְטְעַן Gravari, onere premi, debilitari, infirmari. Aph. אַטְעַן Portare, reportare, referre.
טְעִין Ch. Onuftus, oneratus. Plur. טְעִינִין. Fœmin. טְעִינָא Onufta, onerata. Plur. טְעִינָן.
טְעוּן, טְעוּנָא, טְעוּן Ch. Onus, farcina, fasciculus. Plural. טְעוּנִין, טְעוּנִי. Contracte טון, vide fuprà in טון.
ܛܥܢ Syr. Idem. 1. ad Theff. 5. 14. Item Ratio, Judicium, Actor. 24. 3. Idem quod Chald. מַעֲמָא.
מוֹעֲנָא Ch. Idem. Item Saccus. Vide præterea fuprà in טון.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldean words are transcribed as printed; several Syriac and Hebrew forms are approximate and marked as uncertain where the scan is unclear. The final line טעש is a catchword-like word in Hebrew at the foot right; it is recorded as the last line of text.
